points.en: United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) is a specialized agency of the UN.
points.hi: United Nations Industrial Development Organization (UNIDO) is a specialized agency of the UN.

points.en: Primary objective: Promote and accelerate industrial development in developing countries and economies in transition.

points.en: Focus areas: Poverty reduction through productive activities, trade capacity building, and energy/environment sustainability.
